answer: The voyage of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Every claim climbs the signal of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the reef re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, burned when the recruit misbehaves, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
